blocks.text:
Transfer to the airport (driver only) and flight to Patagonia. Meet and transfer to the hotel with an English-speaking guide. Check-in at EOLO (Corner Room).

In the evening — "Nativo Experience": a 4x4 journey along the shores of Lake Argentino to the Cuevas de Walichu — an archaeological site on rocky cliffs overlooking the lake and the Cordillera de los Andes. Here, rock paintings left by the Tehuelche people thousands of years ago have been preserved — a window into Patagonia's ancient history. The excursion concludes with an authentic Patagonian dinner inside the cave itself, with an English-speaking guide, beneath a starlit sky in the silence of the steppe.
